fusions.name: Split Decision
fusions.desc: Throws a prong that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for the same damage. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Crossed Signposts
fusions.desc: Turns up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles against each other for 5 seconds, dealing 10 damage to each and knocking each back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Two Places at Once
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds and slips you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Follow-On Prong
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
